The best part is it’s completely free to play and we’re offering $150K in total prizes this year!

- Create up to 25 brackets and enter each bracket in up to 10 different groups to play against friends, celebrities, ESPN personalities, and fans across the nation.
- Fill out your Women’s Tournament Challenge brackets directly in the app! Create up to 25 different brackets for the women’s tourney and use Bracket Predictor and Bracket Analyzer to help you make the most informed picks.

- View details on each matchup to make informed picks, including season and historical performance information for each team and video previews for each game of the tournament.
